query:
UPDATE merchants
            SET 
                legal_name = COALESCE($2, legal_name),
                dba = COALESCE($3, dba),
                mcc = COALESCE($4, mcc),
                country = COALESCE($5, country),
                business_type = COALESCE($6, business_type),
                updated_at = NOW()
            WHERE id = $1
